items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: That's his son I'm talking about. Paul was a drummer.

ctx.x: As you were saying, it's good to catch up on a few of these little things that we might forget later. Who was the fellow that you told us about that took the clarinet apart and ended up playing on the mouthpiece?
Paul Moyer. Paul was a drummer, huh? He was a fellow that played with Paul Moyer. No, played with an old man Moyer. That's his son I'm talking about. Paul was a drummer.
What was his son's name? He wanted to play the clarinet.
